get.description: Lists the stacks of the project, with filters and pagination.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Project id (filled automatically with the project acted on).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status, e.g. CREATE_COMPLETE, UPDATE_FAILED.

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Stacks having all these comma-separated tags.

parameters.name: marker
parameters.description: Id of the last stack of the previous page.

parameters.name: sort_keys
parameters.description: Sort key: stack_name, stack_status, creation_time or updated_time.

post.description: Creates a stack from a HOT template. The stack is built asynchronously: poll its status and events.

parameters.name: tenant_id
parameters.description: Project id (filled automatically with the project acted on).

stack_name.description: Name of the stack (letters, digits, _ - .; starts with a letter).

template.description: HOT template, as an object or a YAML/JSON string. Either template or template_url.

parameters.description: Values of the template parameters, {"name": value}.

files.description: Files referenced by the template or environment, {"path": "content"}.

timeout_mins.description: Timeout of the operation, in minutes.

disable_rollback.description: Keep the resources after a failure (default true).
